content:
maria (AE): Heads-up — AcmeHealth wants a CEO-level touchpoint tomorrow AM about data residency and a signed timeline for an on-prem pilot. CEO expects answers, not tech slides.
alex (CRO): can we get a 30m bridge? they specifically asked for our CEO + their CIO.
maria (AE): yes, scheduling 9:30am PT. need a one-page exec brief + clear asks.
devon (SE): what are the technical must-haves for the brief? network, encryption, and expected throughput?
maria (AE): network peering, BYO-KMS, and SLA for 99.9% uptime with a 50 TPS baseline. pricing will be in question too.
karen (Security): i can own the security Qs. i'll prepare short bullets for: data residency options (region vs air-gapped), KMS integration steps, and audit logs retention.
jess (CTO): engineering needs clear commitment windows. we can commit to a staged on-prem pilot: 
```
Stage 1: VPC-deployed private agent (2 weeks)
Stage 2: Full on-prem package + KMS integration (6-8 weeks)
Stage 3: Throughput validation + SLA negotiation (2 weeks)
```
maria (AE): perfect. Sales needs a pricing anchor for execs — what discount range can we offer for a 12-month committed Dedicated contract tied to pilot success?
alex (CRO): propose a 15-20% deal-level credit + pilot support hours. note: finance must approve any below list-price comp.
karen (Security): also add: we require an NDA amendment to include SOC2 subservicer addendum language. i'll draft the exact clauses.
devon (SE): technical ask: we need to confirm whether AcmeHealth's firewall allows persistent websocket connections for streaming; if not, fallback is chunked polling. can someone confirm with their network team?
maria (AE): i'll ping their network lead now. @ops-bot can you create a shared doc template for the exec brief and attach the security bullets?
ops-bot: created doc at https://redwood.app/briefs/acmehealth-1749999999 — shared with thread participants.
alex (CRO): good — i'll join the call and drive the commercial points. maria, can you also include a one-line escalation path if we need execs to intervene post-call?
maria (AE): yes — include: "For unresolved technical blockers, redirect to jess (CTO) and alex (CRO) for exec engagement."
jess (CTO): FYI: if they request data to remain on-prem for the pilot, we require physical co-ordination with their infra team and our deployment engineers to be scheduled next week. that may shift the Stage 2 timeline by a week.
karen (Security): security checklist (short):
- Data residency: region options vs air-gapped pilot
- KMS: BYO-KMS supported (PKCS11/HSM) — integration ETA 4-6 weeks
- Logging: 90d retention configurable
- Compliance: SOC2 + supplemental attestation (drafting)

maria (AE): thanks. action items: 
• devon: validate websocket vs polling (ETA 2h)
• karen: share security bullets in doc (ETA 3h)
• jess/devops: confirm on-prem schedule impact (ETA EOD)
• alex: draft pricing anchor + approval path (ETA 4h)
• maria: finalize calendar invite + exec brief (ETA 1.5h)

ops-bot: calendar invite sent to acmehealth-cio@acmehealth.com and participants for 2026-03-24 09:30 PT.
devon (SE): websocket check: their firewall blocks long-lived websockets by default; need port 443 allow + keepalive. fallback ready (chunked polling).
karen (Security): dropped security bullets into the doc and added the NDA amendment snippet. link: https://redwood.app/briefs/acmehealth-1749999999#security
alex (CRO): pricing anchor posted in doc. i've noted finance approval needed for anything below 12% off list. recommending we start at 18% and negotiate.
jess (CTO): on-prem scheduling note: deployment team can slot a kickoff next Thursday if AcmeHealth signs the pilot SOW by Friday. else push to next month.
maria (AE): all set for prepping exec brief. will post final one-pager in the doc in 45m and include slides for the CEO call.
alex (CRO): thanks everyone — i'll prep talking points for risk/ROI and concession guardrails. :thumbsup:
maria (AE): if anything urgent pops up, ping this thread. otherwise i'll close out after i post the brief.
ops-bot: thread pinned to #sales for visibility by execs.
